message:
Now I can see the fix. The vulnerable version uses `malloc(size)` for `uncompressedData` without initializing it, and then passes it to `LZ4F_uncompressedUpdate`. The fix changed this to use data from the producer instead.

Let me check if the current version in the repo is the vulnerable one or the fixed one:

<｜｜DSML｜｜
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lz4 && git log --oneline -1 && echo "---" && git log --oneline --all -- ossfuzz/round_trip_frame_uncompressed_fuzzer.c | head -5 && echo "---" && git merge-base --is-ancestor 910ec80 HEAD && echo "910ec80 is ancestor of HEAD" || echo "910ec80 is NOT ancestor of HEAD"</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
